summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, announcing via press release a strategic exploration of the global data centre industry and entry into civil nuclear electricity generation. No specific deal terms, stake, price, or timeline were disclosed; the filing outlines general intentions to diversify into AI-related services and data centre construction, cooling peripherals, and hardware trading. The board has not made a recommendation or named advisors. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as a current report. The filing is exploratory rather than a concrete transaction, with no binding agreements. Watch for future definitive agreements or capital deployment plans. No risk-arb angle yet.
